name: hangar-dev
description: Dev/test harness for the Hangar Cockpit plugin (not shipped).
//coverage: Coverage is measured over js/ only. tests/ is excluded because a test file's own coverage says nothing, and libexec/hangar-run is Python, driven as a subprocess by tests/integration and invisible to node. `make coverage` prints the same caveat where a reader of the number will see it.
//thresholds: Floors, not targets: a shade under what the suite achieves today, so code that arrives untested fails the run rather than quietly moving the number down. Raise them when the real figures rise; never lower them to make a red run green. Kept in step with COVERAGE_MIN in the Makefile.
